instant-p2p.safety_warning.heading: §lWarning!
instant-p2p.safety_warning.message:
This instant-p2p mod only helps you connect to a LAN server.
We take no responsibility for problems between users, whether during or after connecting.
Your IP may be exposed over P2P - enable 'Force Relay' to prevent that.
Be careful of untrusted servers asking for personal info, external links, or program installs!
instant-p2p.streamer_protection.heading: §lNotice!
instant-p2p.streamer_protection.message:
Streamer protection is now active.
A streamer whose account is linked and currently broadcasting is granted
the authority to kick or temp-ban users, to keep their broadcast running smoothly.
instant-p2p.join_broadcast_warning.messa:
This room has broadcasting disallowed! Still want to join?
If you're currently streaming, please switch the broadcast filter to 'Broadcast-allowed only'!
instant-p2p.join_capacity_warning.messag:
This room is full.
You are entering anyway using your developer/supporter privilege.
instant-p2p.custom_room.title: Create Room
instant-p2p.custom_room.allow_broadcast_: When on, this room is classified as broadcast-allowed in the room list's filter. Only turn this on if you're fine with your room showing up on livestreams etc (default: off)
instant-p2p.custom_room.public_allow_too: Lists this room publicly in the room list
instant-p2p.force_relay_tooltip: Always routes through the relay instead of connecting directly, so your IP isn't exposed (adds some latency)
instant-p2p.channel.title: Channel Settings
instant-p2p.channel.rule.tooltip:
or: each channel separately
and: all combined into one channel
instant-p2p.channel.desc: Only players on the same channel see each other. Separate several with commas. Clear the field to reset.
instant-p2p.channel.rule.desc.or: Each channel above counts on its own. You see anyone sharing at least one.
instant-p2p.channel.rule.desc.and: All channels above form one combined channel. You only see players using the same set with and.
